dedupe_keys.name: official statistics portal of latvia population and housing census 2011 and 2021 dwelling tables piped water flush toilet central heating by period of construction for regions municipalities and riga neighbourhoods pxweb api

description: The Central Statistical Bureau of Latvia publishes the housing results of the 2011 and 2021 population and housing censuses in the PxWeb database of the Official Statistics Portal. Eight tables in the folder Number of dwellings cover living quarters, floor space, density, ownership, persons per dwelling, type of building and year of construction. Table MAS080 counts conventional dwellings and the persons living in them by occupancy status, period of construction and amenities: flush toilet, piped water, fixed bath or shower and central heating, each with a no and a not stated class. Every table goes down to 211 territorial units, including the cities and municipalities as they were before the 2021 administrative reform and 84 neighbourhoods. Coverage is national: for 2021 the API returned 1,063,939 conventional dwellings, of which 938,526 had piped water, 867,304 a flush toilet and 747,519 central heating. Format and access: free, no registration; the PxWeb API accepts a JSON query and returns CSV, JSON or PX. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: municipalities follow the pre 2021 boundaries; central heating is not split by heat source in this table. Simulation uses: neighbourhood and municipal counts of dwellings on piped water, flush toilets and central heat for network planning and heat demand models, and building age for exposure. Related records: the Estonia REL2021 dwelling amenities tables and the Lithuania census 2021 dwelling amenities API.
